parts.text: Each drone has a home site, and each company has its own charging pads at its own sites, which are never lent to another company. Drones fly along corridors between named sites, and sites have only so many places where drones can take off and land at the same time. I want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts, though our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us.
